FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Q1: How do I generate my first product video?
FAQ.A1: Click Upload, choose a product image or enter a text prompt, and our AI will generate your video. Clearer inputs yield better results.
FAQ.Q2: Can I control the visual style?
FAQ.A2: Yes. Describe the scene or style you want in the prompt — our AI will match it accordingly.
FAQ.Q3: What's included in the free trial?
FAQ.A3: You get 5 free credits to explore different generation styles. Each creation uses 1 credit.
FAQ.Q4: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQ.A4: Email our support team to cancel. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing period.
FAQ.A5: We offer monthly and annual subscriptions, plus one-time credit packs.
FAQ.Q6: Which plan offers the best value?
FAQ.A6: The annual plan offers the lowest cost per credit — ideal for sellers with ongoing content needs.
